about.title: Free AI for Everyone, Truly Free
about.subtitle: A simple project that gives anyone access to powerful artificial intelligence — no signup, no credit card, no limits. Just type and get answers.
about.value_2_title: Your Key Stays in Your Browser
about.what_content: Free AI is a web application that lets you chat with powerful large language models through Groq's infrastructure. You can ask questions, get help writing or reviewing code, brainstorm ideas, summarize text, translate languages, and much more — all from a clean chat interface in your browser. No account to create, no software to install.
about.step_1_desc: Click the Chat link in the navigation bar to open the conversation window.
about.step_2_desc: When you first visit, click "Set API Key" and paste your key. It is stored only in your web browser — never on any server or database we control. It stays there until you clear your browser data.
about.step_3_desc: Type your question or message and press Enter. The AI responds instantly, just like a conversation with a knowledgeable friend.
about.api_content_1: Free AI uses Groq as its underlying provider to run conversations through a large language model. Groq requires every user to have their own API key — this is how they identify and bill users for compute resources.
about.api_content_2: We never store, touch, or see your API key. It lives exclusively in your browser's local storage and travels directly from your machine to Groq. You can set, change, or remove it at any time by clicking the key button in the chat header.
about.api_how_to_get_title: How to Get a Groq API Key
about.api_how_to_get_1: Go to console.groq.com and create a free account.
about.api_how_to_get_2: Navigate to the API Keys section in your dashboard.
about.api_how_to_get_3: Click "Create Key" — you will get a string starting with gsk_. Copy and paste it into Free AI.
about.api_note: Groq offers free tiers for personal use. You only pay if you exceed the free quota, and you can set spending limits in your Groq dashboard to avoid surprises. There are zero requirements to enter a credit card just to get started.
about.why_1_desc: Powerful AI should not be behind paywalls and account gates. Everyone deserves instant access to helpful tools regardless of their background or resources.
about.why_2_desc: Your API key, your conversations, your data — nothing is sent to us. We are a thin interface between you and the AI provider with no tracking infrastructure.
about.why_3_desc: No registration, no email verification, no onboarding flow. Open the page, paste one key, start talking to AI in under ten seconds.
about.why_4_desc: Free AI is a labour-of-love project built on top of open-source tooling and accessible by design. It will stay free because that is the only way it makes sense to exist.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Your data stays with you. Here is how Free AI handles information — or doesn't.
privacy.1_content: Free AI does not collect, store, or process any personal information. We do not require accounts, use tracking cookies, or log IP addresses. There is no analytics, no advertising, and no data to sell.
privacy.2_content: Your Groq API key is stored exclusively in your browser's local storage. It never leaves your device except when you send a request directly to Groq. We have no way to access your key or use it on your behalf.
privacy.3_content: Free AI stores only two things locally: your API key and your language preference (en or fi). These are saved using localStorage so they persist between visits. You can remove them at any time by clearing your browser's site data.
privacy.4_content: When you use the app, your messages are sent directly to Groq's API servers. Groq's own privacy policy governs that data — Free AI has no control over it. We recommend reviewing Groq's privacy policy for details.
privacy.5_content: If you submit the contact form, your name, email address, and message are processed solely to deliver your inquiry to our inbox via a secure SMTP connection. The data is not stored or sold.
privacy.6_content: Free AI uses only essential browser storage for language preference (en/fi). We do not use cookies, pixels, analytics scripts, or any other tracking technologies.
privacy.7_content: Since we collect no data whatsoever, children can use Free AI without concern. There is nothing to protect and nothing to leak.
privacy.8_content: If our practices change in a way that affects this policy, we will update this page and note the revision date at the top. Check back periodically for updates.
privacy.contact_text: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at

terms.2_content: Free AI is provided at no cost. We reserve the right to modify availability or features at any time, but we have no intention of introducing paid tiers or mandatory sign-ups.
terms.3_content: You are responsible for keeping your Groq API key secure. Free AI does not see your key and cannot reset it. If your key is compromised, revoke it in your Groq dashboard and generate a new one.

terms.5_content: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Free AI and its contributors shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, special, consequential, or punitive damages arising from your use of the application.
terms.6_content: You agree not to misuse the service, attempt to reverse-engineer our infrastructure, or use the app for unlawful purposes. Your interactions with Groq's API are governed by Groq's own terms of service.
terms.7_content: The design and code of Free AI are open-source under the MIT License. The content you generate through AI models belongs to you, but we claim no rights over it.
terms.8_content: You may stop using Free AI at any time, for any reason. We do not restrict access or impose account bans — this is a free service with no gatekeeping.

cookies.title: Cookies Policy
cookies.subtitle: What local storage Free AI uses and what it is for.
cookies.1_content: Free AI does not use traditional cookies. Instead, we store two items in your browser's localStorage: your language preference (en or fi) and your Groq API key. Neither of these is transmitted to our servers.
cookies.2_content: We save your chosen language in localStorage under the key free-ai-lang. This ensures your interface remains in your selected language between visits. You can remove it by clearing browser site data.
cookies.3_content: Free AI does not use any analytics, tracking, advertising, or social media pixels. We have no interest in collecting data about your browsing habits.
cookies.4_content: To remove all data stored by Free AI, clear your browser's site data for this domain. This removes both the language preference and your API key from localStorage.
cookies.5_content: When you interact with third-party services (e.g., clicking a social media link), those services may set their own cookies. Free AI has no control over these and recommends reviewing their respective privacy policies.
